historical_nodes.name: memory.go
historical_nodes.summary: Conversation memory layer that compresses chat history into a persistent TaskState via LLM summarization, with incremental updates, token estimation and open-loop filtering to keep the agent context small.

historical_nodes.name: TaskState
historical_nodes.summary: Persistent structured summary of the user's ongoing tasks (goals, open loops, key facts) used as compressed long-term conversational memory.

historical_nodes.name: maybeCompressHistory
historical_nodes.summary: Compresses older chat history into the TaskState summary when the short-term token estimate exceeds the threshold.

historical_nodes.name: summarizeConversationToTaskState
historical_nodes.summary: LLM call that folds an old conversation slice into an updated TaskState JSON summary.

historical_nodes.name: buildTaskStateContext
historical_nodes.summary: Renders the stored TaskState into a prompt-ready context block for the agent's system prompt.

historical_nodes.name: skill_execution_handlers.go
historical_nodes.summary: Synchronous execution handlers for the four management skills (trader, exchange, model, strategy): parse user text into typed patches, apply and persist config updates, run bulk deletes, and collect and format trader-diagnosis evidence with LLM reasoning.

historical_nodes.name: executeTraderManagementAction
historical_nodes.summary: End-to-end trader management executor: create/update/start/stop/bind traders from parsed user text with confirmation and validation.

historical_nodes.name: executeExchangeManagementAction
historical_nodes.summary: Applies exchange-config management actions (create, update keys, enable/disable, delete) parsed from user text.

historical_nodes.name: executeModelManagementAction
historical_nodes.summary: Applies AI-model management actions (create, update API keys/URLs, enable/disable, delete) parsed from user text.

historical_nodes.name: executeStrategyManagementAction
historical_nodes.summary: Applies strategy management actions (create, activate, update config/prompt, delete) parsed from user text, including pending-update confirmation flows.

historical_nodes.name: applyStrategyConfigPatch
historical_nodes.summary: Applies a single parsed field/value patch onto a StrategyConfig, handling every supported config field with validation and clamping.

historical_nodes.name: executeBulkTraderDelete
historical_nodes.summary: Deletes all of a user's traders after explicit confirmation, reporting per-trader results.

historical_nodes.name: formatTraderDiagnosisEvidence
historical_nodes.summary: Formats collected trader-diagnosis evidence (decisions, balances, positions, errors) into a localized report for the user.

historical_nodes.name: entity_field_catalog.go
historical_nodes.summary: Static catalogs of editable/updatable fields for trader, model, and exchange entities, with bilingual keyword synonyms used for intent matching and capability filtering in the conversational agent.

historical_nodes.name: i18n.go
historical_nodes.summary: Bilingual (Chinese/English) message catalog and lookup helper for NOFXi user-facing responses such as help, status, and trader-related texts.

historical_nodes.name: msg
historical_nodes.summary: Looks up a message key in the bilingual catalog for the given language, falling back to English and then the key itself.

historical_nodes.name: model_provider_catalog.go
historical_nodes.summary: Catalog of supported AI model providers (DeepSeek, Qwen, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, MiniMax, Claw402) with default models, credential labels, and step-by-step bilingual setup and credential guidance used by the agent's model-configuration skill.

historical_nodes.name: supportedModelProviders
historical_nodes.summary: Returns the full ordered list of supported AI model provider specs — DeepSeek, Qwen, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, MiniMax, Claw402 — with default models and capability flags.

historical_nodes.name: defaultModelConfigName
historical_nodes.summary: Derives the default display/config name for a provider's model configuration.

historical_nodes.name: modelProviderCredentialLabel
historical_nodes.summary: Returns the localized credential label (API key vs wallet credential) for a provider.

historical_nodes.name: modelProviderSummaryList
historical_nodes.summary: Renders a numbered bilingual summary list of providers for the model-selection prompt, flagging recommendations.

historical_nodes.name: modelProviderDetailedGuidance
historical_nodes.summary: Returns step-by-step bilingual setup guidance — where to get API keys, base URLs, and model names — for a specific provider.

historical_nodes.name: modelProviderCredentialGuidance
historical_nodes.summary: Returns bilingual guidance for entering provider credentials, including the Claw402 config-page wallet flow.

historical_nodes.name: preferences.go
historical_nodes.summary: Persistent per-user preference storage: durable user instructions with a 500-character limit, CRUD operations over the config store, FNV-hash session-to-user key mapping, and prompt-context rendering.

historical_nodes.name: PersistentPreference
historical_nodes.summary: A durable user instruction (ID, text, created-at) shown in the UI and injected into the agent context for future conversations.

historical_nodes.name: NewPersistentPreference
historical_nodes.summary: Validates and constructs a PersistentPreference with a timestamp-derived ID, enforcing the 500-character limit.

historical_nodes.name: SessionUserIDFromKey
historical_nodes.summary: Maps a session key string to a stable numeric user ID via FNV hashing.

historical_nodes.name: getPersistentPreferences
historical_nodes.summary: Loads the user's persistent preferences list from the config store.

historical_nodes.name: savePersistentPreferences
historical_nodes.summary: Persists the preferences list as JSON in the config store.

historical_nodes.name: addPersistentPreference
historical_nodes.summary: Validates and appends a new preference, persisting the updated list.

historical_nodes.name: updatePersistentPreference
historical_nodes.summary: Updates an existing preference's text by ID and persists the list.

historical_nodes.name: deletePersistentPreference
historical_nodes.summary: Deletes a preference by ID (or index fallback) and persists the remaining list.

historical_nodes.name: buildPersistentPreferencesContext
historical_nodes.summary: Renders stored preferences as a numbered prompt-context block injected into the agent system prompt.

historical_nodes.name: sentinel.go
historical_nodes.summary: Market sentinel that scans a mutable watchlist and emits price-breakout, volume-spike, and funding-rate Signals through a callback (consumed by Brain) for proactive alerts.

historical_nodes.name: Signal
historical_nodes.summary: A market alert (type, symbol, severity, title, detail, price, change) delivered to the signal callback.

historical_nodes.name: Sentinel
historical_nodes.summary: Watchlist scanner that polls market data per symbol and emits price-breakout, volume-spike, and funding-rate signals via a SignalCallback.

historical_nodes.name: NewSentinel
historical_nodes.summary: Constructs a Sentinel with initial symbols, signal callback, and logger.

historical_nodes.name: Start
historical_nodes.summary: Launches the periodic watchlist scan loop in a safe named goroutine.

historical_nodes.name: AddSymbol
historical_nodes.summary: Adds a symbol to the watchlist if not already present, returning whether it was added.

historical_nodes.name: RemoveSymbol
historical_nodes.summary: Removes a symbol from the watchlist, returning whether it was present.

historical_nodes.name: FormatWatchlist
historical_nodes.summary: Renders the current watchlist with latest cached prices for user display.

historical_nodes.name: check
historical_nodes.summary: Fetches ticker data for one symbol (256KB read limit) and evaluates price-breakout, volume-spike, and funding-rate thresholds, emitting signals.

historical_nodes.name: skill_dag_runtime.go
historical_nodes.summary: Runtime cursor over a skill DAG: resolves the session's current step from the _dag_step field, sets/clears it, and advances to the next step.

historical_nodes.name: currentSkillDAGStep
historical_nodes.summary: Resolves the session's current DAG step from the _dag_step field, defaulting to the first step of the skill's DAG.

historical_nodes.name: advanceSkillDAGStep
historical_nodes.summary: Advances the session's DAG cursor to the next step of the current step, clearing it at terminal steps.

historical_nodes.name: skill_registry.go
historical_nodes.summary: Loads embedded JSON skill definitions into a global registry at init and generates the prompt-context summaries (routing, definitions, dependencies, action contracts, field knowledge, forbidden behaviors) that teach the NOFXi agent LLM how each skill must be invoked.
historical_nodes.languageNotes: Uses go:embed skill JSON files plus a sync.Map cache for expensive prompt-context strings.

historical_nodes.name: SkillDefinition
historical_nodes.summary: Declarative skill definition loaded from embedded JSON: intents, capabilities, actions, tool mapping, field constraints, and validation rules.

historical_nodes.name: SkillFieldConstraint
historical_nodes.summary: Per-field constraint metadata (type, required, allowed values, aliases, bounds, HTTPS/pattern rules) used for slot validation and prompt field knowledge.

historical_nodes.name: SkillActionDefinition
historical_nodes.summary: Describes one skill action: required/optional slots, confirmation requirement, goal, dynamic rules, and success/failure output templates.

historical_nodes.name: loadSkillRegistry
historical_nodes.summary: Reads the embedded skills/*.json definitions, normalizes each, and returns the name-keyed registry map.

historical_nodes.name: normalizeSkillDefinition
historical_nodes.summary: Normalizes a parsed skill definition, applying defaults and canonical forms to fields, actions, and constraints before registry insertion.

historical_nodes.name: buildSkillRoutingSummary
historical_nodes.summary: Builds the localized routing summary listing each skill and its intents for the router prompt.

historical_nodes.name: buildSkillDefinitionSummary
historical_nodes.summary: Renders a localized per-skill definition summary (description, capabilities, actions) for prompt context.

historical_nodes.name: buildSkillDependencySummary
historical_nodes.summary: Summarizes cross-skill dependencies relevant to the current session for the prompt.

historical_nodes.name: buildSkillActionContractSummary
historical_nodes.summary: Renders the action contract (slots, confirmation, outputs) of the session's active skill actions for the LLM.

historical_nodes.name: buildSkillForbiddenSummary
historical_nodes.summary: Lists localized forbidden behaviors per skill so the LLM avoids out-of-contract actions.

historical_nodes.name: buildManagementSkillContext
historical_nodes.summary: Assembles the full management-skill prompt context (routing, definitions, contracts) for a session.

historical_nodes.name: buildSkillActionRoutingSummary
historical_nodes.summary: Builds the localized action-level routing summary mapping user intents to skill actions.

historical_nodes.name: buildManagementSkillRoutingContextWithSession
historical_nodes.summary: Builds the management-skill routing context enriched with session state.

historical_nodes.name: buildCurrentSkillExecutionContext
historical_nodes.summary: Describes the currently executing skill and action state for the prompt.

historical_nodes.name: buildSkillFieldKnowledgeSummary
historical_nodes.summary: Renders localized field-knowledge lines (types, allowed values, bounds) for the active skill's fields.

historical_nodes.name: orderedSkillFieldKeys
historical_nodes.summary: Orders a skill's field keys with action-required slots first for stable prompt output.

historical_nodes.name: formatFieldKnowledgeLine
historical_nodes.summary: Formats one field's constraint metadata into a localized human-readable prompt line.

historical_nodes.name: fieldKnowledgeDisplayName
historical_nodes.summary: Maps a field key to its localized display name.

historical_nodes.name: missingRequiredActionSlots
historical_nodes.summary: Returns the required slots of a skill action that are still missing from collected values.

historical_nodes.name: cachedSkillContext
historical_nodes.summary: Memoizes expensive skill-context prompt strings in a sync.Map keyed by context kind and language.

historical_nodes.name: stream_text.go
historical_nodes.summary: Splits assistant reply text into small chunks and emits them as SSE delta events, simulating incremental streaming for non-streaming responses.

historical_nodes.name: splitStreamText
historical_nodes.summary: Splits reply text into small chunks on natural boundaries so it can be emitted as incremental SSE deltas.

historical_nodes.name: web.go
historical_nodes.summary: HTTP layer for the NOFXi agent: chat and SSE chat-stream endpoints carrying per-request store-user ID and session-policy context, plus public market-data endpoints (klines, ticker, batch tickers) that proxy Binance and merge stock quotes.
historical_nodes.languageNotes: Session policy and store-user ID travel via context.Context values so agent internals never touch Gin directly.

historical_nodes.name: SessionPolicy
historical_nodes.summary: Per-request capability flags (authenticated, admin, can execute trades, can view secrets) carried through context into the agent.

historical_nodes.name: WebHandler
historical_nodes.summary: HTTP handler wrapping the Agent with a logger, exposing chat, streaming, and market-data endpoints.

historical_nodes.name: WithStoreUserID
historical_nodes.summary: Attaches the store user ID to a context for downstream agent calls.

historical_nodes.name: WithSessionPolicy
historical_nodes.summary: Attaches a SessionPolicy to a context for downstream permission checks.

historical_nodes.name: NewWebHandler
historical_nodes.summary: Constructs a WebHandler bound to an Agent and logger.

historical_nodes.name: HandleHealth
historical_nodes.summary: Liveness endpoint returning a static OK response.

historical_nodes.name: HandleChat
historical_nodes.summary: Handles POST chat requests: decodes the message, routes it through the agent for the context's store user, and returns the reply JSON.

historical_nodes.name: HandleChatStream
historical_nodes.summary: Handles streaming chat over SSE: forwards agent events as SSE frames with heartbeats and client-disconnect handling.

historical_nodes.name: HandleKlines
historical_nodes.summary: Public endpoint proxying Binance klines for a symbol/interval to the frontend chart.

historical_nodes.name: HandleTicker
historical_nodes.summary: Public endpoint proxying a single Binance 24h ticker.

historical_nodes.name: HandleTickers
historical_nodes.summary: Batch ticker endpoint: fans out concurrent panic-safe fetches per symbol, merging Binance tickers and stock quotes into one response.

historical_nodes.name: proxyBinance
historical_nodes.summary: Fetches a Binance REST URL with timeout and copies the response through to the client.

historical_nodes.name: skill_management_handlers.go
historical_nodes.summary: Largest chat-skill module: management and creation skill handlers for traders, exchanges, models, and strategies — bulk/target resolution, strategy-create draft state machine with typed defaults and field hints, bilingual draft summaries, and describe-entity responses mirroring the manual pages.
historical_nodes.languageNotes: Strategy-create drafts are JSON round-tripped through session fields; extensive zh/en formatting helpers keep chat output aligned with the manual UI.

historical_nodes.name: handleTraderManagementSkill
historical_nodes.summary: Routes trader-management skill turns (start/stop/delete/update) to the simple-entity handler with trader options.

historical_nodes.name: handleExchangeManagementSkill
historical_nodes.summary: Routes exchange-management skill turns to the simple-entity handler with exchange options.

historical_nodes.name: handleModelManagementSkill
historical_nodes.summary: Routes model-management skill turns to the simple-entity handler with model options.

historical_nodes.name: handleStrategyManagementSkill
historical_nodes.summary: Routes strategy-management skill turns to the simple-entity handler with strategy options.

historical_nodes.name: applyStrategyCreateTypeDefaults
historical_nodes.summary: Applies type-specific defaults (AI vs grid) to a strategy-create draft config.

historical_nodes.name: formatStrategyCreateFinalConfirmation
historical_nodes.summary: Renders the final bilingual confirmation summary of a strategy-create draft before saving.

historical_nodes.name: describeStrategy
historical_nodes.summary: Loads a strategy by reference and returns its formatted detail response.

historical_nodes.name: formatStrategyDetailResponse
historical_nodes.summary: Formats a full strategy detail view (coin source, indicators, risk control, prompts) matching manual-page sections.

historical_nodes.name: describeTrader
historical_nodes.summary: Resolves and describes a trader's configuration and bindings for chat display.

historical_nodes.name: describeExchange
historical_nodes.summary: Describes an exchange config including type-specific visible fields with credentials masked as presence flags.

historical_nodes.name: describeModel
historical_nodes.summary: Describes an AI-model config with masked credentials and wallet balance hints.

historical_nodes.name: loadTraderOptions
historical_nodes.summary: Loads the user's traders as selectable skill options with running-state hints.

historical_nodes.name: handleExchangeCreateSkill
historical_nodes.summary: Drives the exchange-create conversation: infers type/credentials from text, validates the draft, and persists on confirmation.

historical_nodes.name: handleModelCreateSkill
historical_nodes.summary: Drives the model-create conversation: provider-first prompting (Claw402 recommended), credential collection, and creation.

historical_nodes.name: handleStrategyCreateSkill
historical_nodes.summary: Drives the strategy-create conversation: type selection, config draft accumulation, and final confirmation.

historical_nodes.name: handleSimpleEntitySkill
historical_nodes.summary: Generic mutation handler for start/stop/enable/disable/delete actions across entity types with target resolution and bulk support.

historical_nodes.name: skill_semantic_gate.go
historical_nodes.summary: Semantic gate for chat skills: builds per-skill/action summaries of the visible fields and selectable options (matching the manual UI) so the LLM only references fields users can actually edit.

historical_nodes.name: skillVisibleFieldSummary
historical_nodes.summary: Assembles the list of editable field names for a given skill/action, adapting strategy fields to the target's type.

historical_nodes.name: strategyTypeForTarget
historical_nodes.summary: Looks up the strategy type (AI/grid) for a referenced target to select the right field set.

historical_nodes.name: skillVisibleOptionSummary
historical_nodes.summary: Returns the option summary (available choices) for a skill/action, delegating to per-domain summaries.

historical_nodes.name: enumOptionValues
historical_nodes.summary: Enumerates allowed values for enum-like skill fields (exchange types, providers, strategy types).

historical_nodes.name: formatSkillOptionList
historical_nodes.summary: Formats an option list with a bilingual prefix for inclusion in chat replies.

historical_nodes.name: onboard.go
historical_nodes.summary: Guided onboarding conversation for the chat agent: a per-user step state machine that collects exchange and AI-model credentials, persists SetupState in the config store, and finishes by creating and wiring the user's first trader.
historical_nodes.languageNotes: Setup state is serialized into per-user config keys; masked keys and bilingual setup messages guide the flow.

historical_nodes.name: SetupState
historical_nodes.summary: Serializable per-user onboarding state: current step plus collected exchange and AI-model credentials.

historical_nodes.name: getSetupState
historical_nodes.summary: Loads and deserializes a user's onboarding SetupState from the config store.

historical_nodes.name: handleSetupFlowForStoreUser
historical_nodes.summary: Main onboarding dispatcher: routes user text to the current setup step (exchange choice, keys, AI choice) for a store user.

historical_nodes.name: handleExchangeChoice
historical_nodes.summary: Handles the exchange-selection step, matching user text to a supported exchange and advancing the flow.

historical_nodes.name: handleAIChoice
historical_nodes.summary: Handles the AI-provider selection step, mapping user text to provider/model and requesting the API key.

historical_nodes.name: finishSetup
historical_nodes.summary: Final onboarding step: saves exchange and AI-model configs, creates the first trader, and reports the result.

historical_nodes.name: createTraderFromSetupForStoreUser
historical_nodes.summary: Creates the user's first trader record from collected setup state, binding exchange, model, and default strategy.

historical_nodes.name: saveSetupExchange
historical_nodes.summary: Persists the exchange credentials collected during onboarding as an exchange config row.

historical_nodes.name: saveSetupAIModel
historical_nodes.summary: Persists the AI provider/model and API key collected during onboarding as an AI-model config.
